utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Happy to help with the repair drive—what’s the first thing you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Mara — I’m running a little late as usual, but I can start by sorting the donation list and bringing over some tools.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good — I can help sort the donation list once you’re here, and I’ll keep an eye out for the tools.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you confirm the date, exact location, and what items you still need? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I need the date, the exact location, and a quick list of any items still needed. Once I have that, I can share it out.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a quick list of supplies we can pull together for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, great — I can help with that. What do you need me to grab?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Could you grab duct tape, zip ties, and a few trash bags? I’ll handle the rest of the list.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out with the repair drive—what do you need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey. I’m mostly worried about getting the supplies and timing sorted—if you can help with pickup or a list, that would be a huge relief.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can handle the pickup list and check what’s available. Tell me where and when you want the supplies, and I’ll sort the rest.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do we know which repairs need attention first?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces, but I think the roof leaks and the broken steps are the big ones. If you’ve got the list, I’m happy to help sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, let’s start with the roof and steps. Do you know if anyone’s already handling materials or bids?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m hearing the repair drive’s still on, and folks are getting things sorted out. If you want, I can keep an ear out for any updates.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Tess — I’d appreciate that. If you hear anything about tools or parts they still need, let me know and I’ll help out.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Of course — I’ll let you know right away if I hear they still need tools or parts.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Opal — I’m hearing the repair drive’s coming together, and I’m happy to spread the word fast. Want me to invite a few neighbors?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, please invite a few neighbors—especially anyone near the east side. I’ll keep track of who’s coming and where they’re arriving from.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll reach out to a few east-side neighbors first and let you know who’s in.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm you’ll bring the extra extension cords and arrive by 9?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes — I’ll bring the extra extension cords and be there by 9.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Bo — I’m getting the repair drive organized and can use your help if you’re up for it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I’m in — send me the key details and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo — I’m aiming for Saturday morning, and I need help matching volunteers to homes that need small fixes. I’ll send you the list and the sign-up sheet next.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can help spread the word about the repair drive. What day and time should I tell everyone?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple: Saturday at 10 a.m. works best for me. Please tell everyone to meet at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it — I’ll tell everyone to meet at the community center this Saturday at 10 a.m.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I was meaning to check on that. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Just a small flashlight and maybe a sturdy screwdriver, if you’ve got one. I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I can bring a flashlight and I’ll look for a sturdy screwdriver too. I’ll swing by with them.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m thinking the repair drive could really use a simple sign-up sheet and a clear list of needed items. If you want, I can help connect folks and spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That would be great, Jules—thank you. A sign-up sheet and item list would make it so much easier to get people involved.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll put together a simple sign-up sheet and a needed-items list, then share it around the neighborhood. We’ll get more folks involved in no time.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the repair drive? I’m telling everyone about it—want me to pass along the details to a few more neighbors?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, please do—I’ll likely swing by late, but I’d like the details.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll spread the word and send you the details too. If you want, I can mention you’ll be coming by late.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m glad to hear the repair drive is getting started. What do you need help with first?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: First, let’s sort the tools and set a simple schedule. Then we can tackle the biggest repairs one by one.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds good to me. I can help sort the tools and make the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school pickup times for the repair drive—what’s the best window?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be great, Faye—school pickup usually clears up around 3:30, and after 4 works best for most folks. I’ll keep that in mind as we plan.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, I’ll aim for after 4 and keep the school pickup crowd in mind. Let me know if you want me to help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help connect folks for the repair drive — what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Could you help spread the word and see who can bring tools or volunteer time? I’ll keep you posted on the plan.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can spread the word and ask around for tools and volunteers. Keep me posted on the plan, and I’ll start reaching out.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can bring over my tool kit for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Gus — that helps a lot. Just let me know what time you’re coming so I can make sure everything’s ready.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll swing by around 10 a.m. and bring the tool kit with me.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m heading to the repair drive now—do you want me to keep an eye out for any specific drop-off spot?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes please—if there’s a table near the main entrance, that would be perfect. Thank you, Opal!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely—I’ll check for a table by the main entrance and let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Hana, what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m checking the details first, so I don’t want to guess. I’ll let you know as soon as I’ve confirmed the latest.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—just let me know when you’ve confirmed it. If there’s anything I can help check, say the word.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam — could you help gather the tools and any spare parts we’ve got? I’ll keep track of what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll start gathering the tools and spare parts now, and I’ll bring them over once I’ve checked what we have.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces about the repair drive. What’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I think they’re still organizing it, but I may have missed the latest details. Have they set a date yet?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I haven’t heard a date yet either — I just know it’s still being put together. If you hear anything, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So this repair drive is actually happening, right? Just want to make sure before I tell anyone.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s happening for real — folks are bringing in tools, spare parts, and anything else they can spare. I’ll tell you if I hear any changes.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, good — I just wanted to confirm before I pass it along. Let me know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Ira. That means a lot to me.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course — I’ll let you know if I hear anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I meant to bring something by, but I’m a bit scatterbrained today. What do you still need?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Mostly tools and sturdy tape still. If you can swing by, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I can do that — I’ll grab some tools and sturdy tape and swing by soon.
